title: Rock Quality Designation (RQD)
equation: RQD = (Σ lengths of intact core pieces ≥ 100 mm) / L_run × 100%

L_run.description: Total length of core run (typically 1.5 m or 3.0 m)

applicability: Only count hard, sound rock pieces. Exclude drilling-induced breaks (fresh, tight-fitting surfaces, usually perpendicular to axis). Exclude soft weathered zones. Reported per core run. RQD = 0–25: very poor; 25–50: poor; 50–75: fair; 75–90: good; 90–100: excellent.

title: Total Core Recovery (TCR)

L_recovered.description: Total length of all core recovered (all pieces, any condition)

applicability: TCR > 100% is possible if core swells or if previous run stub is recovered. TCR < 100% indicates core loss — record loss zones. Core loss is typically in weak/fractured zones (the most important zones for design).

title: Theoretical RQD from Discontinuity Frequency (Priest & Hudson)

λ.description: Mean discontinuity frequency (number per meter along scanline/core)

applicability: Assumes negative exponential distribution of spacing. Provides theoretical link between RQD and fracture frequency. Useful for converting scanline mapping data to equivalent RQD. At λ = 6/m: RQD ≈ 90%. At λ = 15/m: RQD ≈ 56%. At λ = 30/m: RQD ≈ 16%.

title: True Orientation from Alpha-Beta Angles
equation: True dip/dip direction computed from: α (angle between discontinuity and core axis), β (rotation from reference line), borehole inclination, and borehole azimuth

α.description: Angle between discontinuity trace and core axis (0° = perpendicular to axis, 90° = parallel to axis)

β.description: Clockwise rotation angle from the bottom-of-hole orientation mark to the maximum dip direction of the discontinuity

applicability: Calculation by stereographic projection (graphically) or analytically. Software: DIPS (Rocscience), CoreOrientation. For vertical boreholes: true dip = α, dip direction = β + borehole reference azimuth. For inclined holes: full 3D transformation required.

title: Terzaghi Correction for Orientation Bias in Boreholes

N_apparent.description: Observed count from core or borehole wall

δ.description: Angle between the borehole axis and the normal to the discontinuity set

applicability: Boreholes intersect fewer discontinuities when the set is subparallel to the borehole axis (blind zone: δ > 70–80°). Correction becomes infinite as δ → 90°, so a practical limit of δ ≤ 60–70° is applied. For comprehensive characterization, drill boreholes at different orientations.

title: Core Barrel Bit Clearance and Kerf Width

D_bit_OD.description: Outer diameter of diamond bit (= borehole diameter)

D_bit_ID.description: Inner diameter of diamond bit (= core diameter)

applicability: Standard wireline kerf widths: NQ: (75.7-47.6)/2 = 14 mm. HQ: (96.0-61.1)/2 = 17.5 mm. PQ: (122.6-85.0)/2 = 18.8 mm. Larger kerf → more material removed → slower advance but more annular clearance for cuttings removal.
